name: AITOP10
conditions: Submission is currently free, but the site's own FAQ states: 'you should share a backlink to AITOP10 directory' — a reciprocal-link expectation on the free path.
requirements: AI tools only — directory covers AI chatbots, GPT tools, rewriting assistants, audio editing, video production, writing, drawing, and image processing.
A submit page exists at https://aitop10.tools/submit.
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, and category.
A backlink to aitop10.tools ready to place on your site.
Fallback contact per a third-party profile: support@aitop10.tools.
workflow: Open https://aitop10.tools/submit (linked as 'Submit' in site nav).
Submit the tool details; place the reciprocal backlink to AITOP10.
If the form is unreachable, email support@aitop10.tools per the site's contact guidance.
watchFor: The homepage timed out twice during research — site may be slow or intermittently unreachable; verify availability before planning around it.
Backlink 'should' wording is soft but is the stated condition for free submission — treat it as required.
No pricing tiers or review timeline are published.
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the aitop10.tools explore/directory listing with a detail page linking out to your site.
unknowns: Exact form fields — the submit page was not directly fetched (site timed out for the fetcher; content confirmed via indexed copies).
Review timeline and whether the backlink requirement is enforced or honorary.
